samples.claim: No deploy switches the safety classifier off on a production endpoint unless the lead of the team that owns that endpoint approved the change first.
samples.finding: Violation found: a deploy turned the safety classifier off on a production endpoint without a prior approval from the lead of the team that owns it.
samples.reasoning: The claim under audit is: No deploy switches the safety classifier off on a production endpoint unless the lead of the team that owns that endpoint approved the change first. The deciding details are the approval for another endpoint, approval after the change, recorded in LOG-0016, LOG-0034, LOG-0051, LOG-0057, LOG-0070, LOG-0093, LOG-0106, LOG-0129, LOG-0131, LOG-0136, LOG-0137, LOG-0138. Together these lines show the claim does not hold.
